title: setup: owner invites a friend, the friend accepts, both open the same deck
presence: each sees the other's avatar in the header and on the slide rail
pointer + selection: the friend's cursor and selected element show up on the owner's canvas with her name
text lock: while the friend types in a text box, the owner cannot edit that same box and is told why
live merge: both people change DIFFERENT things at the same moment and both changes survive, with no conflict dialog
noise: console: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 409 (Conflict)

title: undo is per person: the owner's undo reverts the owner's title change, not Maya's note
access ends live: when the owner removes Maya her editor is told immediately
